text:
olivia: Heads-up — we need GPU quota increases for a couple of new AWS accounts so we can onboard the Acme tenant. Targets: p5.xlarge (or equivalent) and g5 instances, plus higher ENI limits for multi-AZ placement groups. Will need this in ca-central-1 and ap-south-1.

olivia: Quick details (masked account ids):
```
Accounts: 1234-xxxx-CA (ca-central-1), 5678-xxxx-IN (ap-south-1)
Requested quotas: p5-family 16 -> 64, g5-family 0 -> 32, p4d 0 -> 8 (we probably won't use p4d immediately)
Network: ElasticNetworkInterfaces increased to 1000, EC2 placement group nic/eni support for cluster networking, ENI per instance bump for g5/p5 families
Priority: onboarding next-week; this is time-sensitive (customer POC).
```

james: copying cloudops and tagging procurement. do we have region-specific AMI or special placement-group needs?

olivia: No special AMI. We will use our standard runtime AMI. But they want strict low-latency intra-node networking, so placement-group + ENI counts matter.

kevin: FYI ENI limits are often the blocker. For new accounts AWS sets default "Elastic Network Interfaces" and "IPv4 addresses per ENI" low. We'll need to request both: 
- Increase "ElasticNetworkInterfaces"
- Increase "IPv4 Addresses per Network Interface" for the instance types
Also ask for "EC2 On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) instances" quota for the relevant families if AWS bundles them weirdly.

cloudops-bot: Created AWS support case 1234567891 for account 1234-xxxx-CA. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567891 (internal)

james: nice. can you set the case severity to Business-Critical? onboarding timeline is tight.

cloudops-bot: Case 1234567891 updated: severity set to "urgent" by james. Estimated response 24-72 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: If AWS pushes back on p5 quotas, fallback plan: use dedicated Redwood pools in the region (we have spare g5 capacity in our eu-west-3 Dedicated ring) and route traffic there for the initial POC. That buys time while the quotas are raised. But watch cross-region egress costs and latency.

sara: tagging @billing-bot — can we pre-approve cost exposure for using dedicated capacity + inter-region transfer for 2 weeks? We need a quick cost estimate.

billing-bot: Noted. Pre-approval required: up to $12k/week for dedicated GPU reserve during POC. Please confirm.

olivia: Confirmed. Approve up to $10k/week for first week; we'll re-evaluate after POC.

james: two more asks for the support case: 1) enable placement group support for p5/g5, 2) check/raise ENI quotas per AZ, not just account-level. AWS sometimes only raises account-level limits and leaves AZ skew.

kevin: Also add request for increased "Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA)" quotas in case the customer requests RDMA later. Better to have it pre-approved.

cloudops-bot: Case 1234567891 updated with placement-group and EFA quota requests. Added note: "AZ-specific increases required".

olivia: Thanks. I'll paste the case summary into the onboarding doc and ping support if we don't hear back by EOD.

james: if we get partial approvals (e.g., g5 but not p5), we should prioritize g5 for POC and schedule p5 ramp after resource availability. Kept as fallback plan.

kevin: reminder: when quotas are increased, we also need to request soft limits on "Spot Instance Pools" if they plan to use spot. AWS sometimes caps spot pools by family.

olivia: Good call. Added spot pools line to the case.

cloudops-bot: AWS case 1234567891 status: initial response received. Support asks for business justification and expected sustained vCPU/GPU per AZ.

olivia: Posted justification in the case: "Acme POC — ML training + inference. Sustained ~48 GPUs across 2 AZs for 2 weeks, then scale to 200 GPUs across region for production. Customer has signed MSA."

james: 👍 ping me if they ask for demand forecast or we need to share commit/contract.

kevin: I'll monitor instance limits in each AZ and coordinate with capacity engineering for pre-warm on Dedicated if needed.

olivia: Next steps: cloudops follow up on case, kevin validate AZ allocation and ENI limits, billing confirmed short-term spend. I'll update onboarding doc and close loop.

sara: thanks team :raised_hands:

olivia: marking this thread for follow-up — will update with final case id(s) and timestamps once AWS confirms.
